description: This file defines an Android Activity named TriangleActivity that initializes a GLSurfaceView with a custom renderer (StaticTriangleRenderer) to display a triangle using OpenGL ES.

classes.name: TriangleActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that sets up a GLSurfaceView with a custom OpenGL renderer to display a triangle.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GLSurfaceView and sets its renderer.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Pauses the GLSurfaceView rendering when the activity is paused.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes the GLSurfaceView rendering when the activity is resumed.
